title: Japan Series tickets
note: Face value goes fast on team sites and Ticket Pia; resale runs higher. Your ceiling is about $200 (¥31,700) a game.

title: Hotel in a Japan Series city
note: Game nights fill hotels near the stadiums. Lock a cancellable room as soon as the dates are set.

title: Shinkansen reserved seat
note: Weekends and game days sell out the window seats. Reserve on SmartEX or JR East, or at a station machine.

title: Koyasan temple stay (shukubo)
note: Autumn weekends book up. Book through the Koyasan tourist association or Japanese Guest Houses.

title: Ryokan / onsen inn night
note: Autumn color season is peak for onsen towns; the good mid-price rooms go first.

title: Famous sushi or kaiseki counter
note: Most top counters only book through hotel concierges or services like Omakase or Tableall.
